caption: With stack $E′T and lookahead *, the entry M[T,*] is empty, so the parser reports the error. Because * is not in FOLLOW(T) = {+, ), $}, it drops the token; the input becomes id $, the entry M[T,id] = T → F T′ fills, and parsing resumes.

spec.title: Panic mode on the worked example
spec.aria: Flowchart of the worked example: the entry M[T,*] is empty so the parser reports an error at *; * is not in FOLLOW(T), so the parser skips the token, the input becomes id $, the entry M[T,id] = T → F T′ becomes available, and parsing resumes and accepts.
